name: @pipeworx/mcp-covalent

tools.name: covalent_token_balances
tools.description: Token balances for wallet X on chain Y — every ERC-20/native token held by an address, with USD quotes. Works across 100+ chains via Covalent/GoldRush. Example: covalent_token_balances({ address: "0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045", chain: "eth-mainnet", _apiKey: "your-key" })

address.description: Wallet address (0x...), ENS name, or other supported domain

chain.description: Chain name (Covalent format), e.g. "eth-mainnet", "matic-mainnet", "base-mainnet", "bsc-mainnet", "arbitrum-mainnet". A numeric chain id also works. Default "eth-mainnet".

_apiKey.description: Covalent / GoldRush API key (free tier at goldrush.dev)

tools.name: covalent_transactions
tools.description: Recent transactions for wallet X on chain Y — latest on-chain transactions for an address with USD-valued amounts and gas. Works across 100+ chains via Covalent/GoldRush. Example: covalent_transactions({ address: "0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045", chain: "eth-mainnet", _apiKey: "your-key" })

address.description: Wallet address (0x...), ENS name, or other supported domain

chain.description: Chain name (Covalent format), e.g. "eth-mainnet", "matic-mainnet", "base-mainnet", "bsc-mainnet", "arbitrum-mainnet". A numeric chain id also works. Default "eth-mainnet".

_apiKey.description: Covalent / GoldRush API key (free tier at goldrush.dev)

tools.name: covalent_token_holders
tools.description: Top holders of token X on chain Y — the largest wallet holders of an ERC-20 token contract, with balances. Works across 100+ chains via Covalent/GoldRush. Example: covalent_token_holders({ token_address: "0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48", chain: "eth-mainnet", _apiKey: "your-key" })

chain.description: Chain name (Covalent format), e.g. "eth-mainnet", "matic-mainnet", "base-mainnet", "bsc-mainnet", "arbitrum-mainnet". A numeric chain id also works. Default "eth-mainnet".

_apiKey.description: Covalent / GoldRush API key (free tier at goldrush.dev)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-covalent forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the covalent pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
